hero.title: Build websites like you build game UI.
hero.subtitle: Anchors, pivots, layout groups and keyframes. Drag it together, hit Build, ship plain HTML.

features.title: RectTransform layout
features.body: Anchors, pivots and offsets exactly like uGUI, plus Horizontal, Vertical and Grid layout groups.

features.title: Keyframe animation
features.body: Dopesheet, curves and record mode. Animate position, anchors, colors, sprites and any property.

features.title: Data binding
features.body: Drop a JSON file in assets and bind it anywhere with {{file:path}}. Repeat over arrays.

features.title: Your own components
features.body: Write components in HTML, CSS and JS, and MonoBehaviour-style scripts with start() and update().

features.title: Assets that just work
features.body: Images, video, audio, fonts and JSON. Drag them from the Project window onto anything.

features.title: Plain static output
features.body: One HTML and CSS file per page with a tiny runtime. Host it anywhere, no build server needed.
